Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the decoded instruction by treating “left word” as “leftmost word,” leading to the hardcoded “Yes No” approach. The correct reading is to write the opposite of the word “left” (i.e., “right”) as the answer. This initial misinterpretation set the task on the wrong path; later, the Planner also introduced a code bug (not reversing the string) but the root, first error was the faulty interpretation.
